8.16.12. iLock_Geography.geo_util.MutableRailyard¶

class iLock_Geography.geo_util.MutableRailyard(graph, paths, areas, auxObjs)¶

A data type used to generate a new railyard after processing and setting coordinate attributes to the containing railyard objects.

Methods

__init__(graph, paths, areas, auxObjs) Constructor.
nodePosition2objectCoord() Copy coordinates from nodes to contained objects
postProcess() Processing to be performed before generating the railyard.
preProcess() Processing to be performed up on the completion of initialization.
railyard([locked]) Return a new processed railyard.
